title: Vegan Double Fried Canadian Tofu Skewers
description: A quick-fix Canadian dish featuring freshly chopped parsley and double-fried tofu, served on a cedar plank. This plant-based friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Toss the tofu cubes in the flour mixture to coat.
Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Double fry the tofu cubes by frying them for 2-3 minutes on each side, then increasing the heat to high and frying for an additional 1-2 minutes on each side.
Thread the fried tofu cubes onto skewers.
Place the skewers on a cedar plank and bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
